sourceFiles: 4-Scope of Supply Rev_SAMART03-unpriced_scope of supply_marked up.xlsx
4-Scope of Supply Rev_SAMART03 (B10)-unpriced_pre-com and com spare_marked up.xlsx

items.title: Trunk Radio: UHF BDA offered in lieu of LNA (RAD-508-001)
items.jutalComment: C1 line 4 clouded: 'DMR is designed on based scope, it is not require BDA'; B10 2.01-2.03 BDA spares struck through.
items.mrRequirement: MR-0002 / DTS specifies LNA receive chain (RFI RX3852-2002-11, NF <= 2 dB).
items.offeredBasis: 3 sets RFI BD4345-00N0-AC + WAROM HRMD95-VIIIB Ex d enclosure at ZWP20, ZWP21, ZWP22.
items.response: C1 item 4 is withdrawn as commented. Part A A2 remains on the submitted UHF BDA configuration as a formal technical deviation pending supplier LNA confirmation.
items.treatment: Formal Technical Deviation (Base A2 retained; C1 line 4 withdrawn)

items.title: SCADA Enclosure Cable Entries (GA Sheet13 vs DTS min 18)
items.jutalComment: Technical clarification on physical cable-end count & GA Sheet13 reconciliation.
items.mrRequirement: DTS-0001 C1 requires minimum 18 cable entries.
items.offeredBasis: SCADA enclosure cable-entry schedule under GA Sheet13 reconciliation.
items.response: Physical cable-end count and entry schedule are being reconciled against GA Sheet13 and DTS-0001 C1 prior to detailed engineering.

items.title: Main Equipment Quantities (1 lot per MR)
items.mrRequirement: Main Equipment per MR-0001 to MR-0004 across listed platforms.
items.offeredBasis: Qty 1 lot per MR covering all platforms listed in Main Specification.
items.response: Qty 1 lot represents one complete system package per MR covering all platforms listed in the Main Specification.

items.title: Special Tools Compliance (MMC25-5001 EXA-A8 5.0)
items.jutalComment: It shall be complied as per CPY's requirement refer to MMC25-5001 EXA-A8 Minimum List of Spare Parts and Special Tools (TETRA struck through).
items.mrRequirement: EXA-A8 5.0 minimum list (SCADA config/NMS SW, RACON config SW & charging kit if applicable; TETRA N/A).
items.offeredBasis: Tools expressly included in the equipment supply remain included; not separately quoted.
items.response: Items 1, 2, 4 and 5 of EXA-A8 5.0 will be complied with, and inclusion within the Part A equipment supply is being confirmed with the OEM. Item 3 (TETRA voice gateway) is not applicable as DMR is selected.

items.title: Layer 3 Switch Ports (TC-0001 Item 13: 4 Copper + 1 SFP Standard Chassis)
items.jutalComment: Customer requires standard module with 4 copper ports + 1 SFP uplink (no expansion module).
items.mrRequirement: LAN-502-001 / LAN-502-002 Industrial Layer 3 Switch per MR-0001 (4 copper + 1 SFP minimum).
items.offeredBasis: Cisco Catalyst IE-3400-8P2S-E standard chassis (8 GE PoE RJ45 + 2 GE SFP built-in; IEM-3300-8T= expansion module excluded).
items.response: Confirmed that Cisco IE-3400-8P2S-E standard chassis natively includes 8 GE PoE copper ports and 2 GE SFP uplinks, satisfying the 4 copper + 1 SFP requirement without an expansion module. Optical/copper SFP transceiver and L3 routing licence level remain subject to site link confirmation.
items.treatment: Technical Clarification (Standard Chassis; No Expansion Module)

items.title: Delivery Term Clarification: CIF Zhuhai Port vs DDP Yard
items.jutalComment: Highlighted yellow: Proposed delivery: CIF Zhuhai Port, China (Incoterms 2020), subject to buyer approval against original DDP site terms.
items.mrRequirement: Original Scope of Supply template specifies DDP Purchaser's Yard.
items.offeredBasis: CIF Zhuhai Port, China (Incoterms 2020); Purchaser handles China import clearance, duty, VAT and port-to-yard.
items.response: Delivery is proposed on CIF Zhuhai Port, China (Incoterms 2020) basis, with China import clearance, duties, and port-to-yard transport by Purchaser, subject to Purchaser confirmation.

items.title: B3 FAT Duration (2+1 vs 5 days) & Item 2 (Offshore SAT) Move to Services
items.jutalComment: Item 1 is considered to be a based scope however 2 + 1 days for FAT may not be satisfied and recommended for 5 days test. Item 2 is required based on position, offshore duty and standby day rated, travel day rated and move it to proposal of services.
items.mrRequirement: FAT at SAMTEL Warehouse (Thailand) + Survey and Offshore SAT.
items.offeredBasis: Integrated FAT at SAMTEL Warehouse, Thailand (2+1 days) + Survey and Offshore SAT (28 working days).
items.response: Item 1 (integrated FAT at SAMTEL Warehouse, Thailand) remains in Base Scope. Extending FAT to 5 days and moving Item 2 (offshore SAT duty, standby, and travel) to the day-rated Proposal of Services per the Schedule of Rates are under commercial review.

items.title: Painting & Protective Coating
items.mrRequirement: Painting and protective coating in accordance with the specification, where required.
items.offeredBasis: Not separately quoted; excluded beyond OEM standard factory finish.
items.response: Equipment is supplied with OEM standard factory protective finish. Any project-specific additional coating beyond OEM standard finish is subject to specification confirmation.

items.title: End-User Training (Drop SAMTEL Warehouse 1+1d, Move Remainder)
items.jutalComment: move out End-user training at SAMTEL Warehouse: 1 day plus 1 reserve day, it's not required and rest move it to proposal of services.
items.mrRequirement: End-user training (4 systems: SCADA, DMR, Ex Phone, RACON).
items.offeredBasis: OEM online instruction with ADDVALUE onsite facilitation at SAMTEL Warehouse (1+1 days).
items.response: Removal of the SAMTEL Warehouse onsite venue days (1 day plus 1 reserve day) and relocation of the residual OEM online instruction and training materials to the Proposal of Services are under commercial review.

items.title: Onshore Specialist Assistance at JUTAL Zhuhai Yard
items.jutalComment: It to proposal of services an make it simple for estimate budget.
items.mrRequirement: Onshore specialist assistance at JUTAL Zhuhai Fabrication Yard.
items.offeredBasis: 2 persons; 7 working days + 2 travel days/person at JUTAL Zhuhai Yard.
items.response: Relocation of onshore specialist assistance at JUTAL Zhuhai Yard to the Proposal of Services on a simplified day-rate schedule per the Schedule of Rates is under commercial review.

items.title: Commissioning Spares (3 Lines Kept, 8 Lines Struck Through in B10 .xlsx)
items.jutalComment: Kept 3 MR-0001 lines (1.01, 1.03, 1.04); struck through 8 lines in red (1.02 PoE injector, 2.01-2.03 MR-0002 BDA spares, 3.01-3.04 MR-0003 Telephone/Sounder spares).
items.mrRequirement: Erection, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up spares.
items.offeredBasis: 11 commissioning spare lines across MR-0001 (4), MR-0002 (3), and MR-0003 (4); RACON excluded.
items.response: Noted on the marked-up B10 schedule (items 1.01, 1.03, 1.04 retained; items 1.02, 2.01-2.03, 3.01-3.04 deleted by Purchaser). Removal of MR-0002 and MR-0003 commissioning spares is flagged for Purchaser confirmation regarding site SAT spare availability.

items.title: First-Filling Materials Clarification
items.jutalComment: To be clarified by vendor and what is concern?
items.mrRequirement: First-filling materials, where required by the equipment specification.
items.offeredBasis: Not quoted; excluded from this offer.
items.response: B12 covers first-filling materials (oils, lubricants, and fluids). The offered telecommunications equipment requires no first-filling materials; therefore this item is not applicable.

items.title: Preservation, Operation & Maintenance Consumables
items.jutalComment: It shall be scope of vendor in lump sum price. / It shall be included scope of vendor that could not be verified.
items.mrRequirement: Consumables for preservation, operation and maintenance.
items.offeredBasis: Included in Base Scope per Annex B13 (3 lines: desiccant, cleaning, resealing/labels).
items.response: B13 preservation, operation and maintenance consumables are included in the vendor lump sum scope per Annex B13.

items.title: Capital Spares (Lines 1.1 & 1.2 Kept; Lines 2, 3, 4, 5 Withdrawn)
items.jutalComment: Lines 1.1 and 1.2 kept; Lines 2, 3, 5 crossed out; Line 4 clouded ('DMR is designed on based scope, it is not require BDA').
items.mrRequirement: Optional capital spares excluded from Total A+B.
items.offeredBasis: 6 optional capital spare lines in Annex C1 (excluded from Total A+B).
items.response: Noted. C1 is revised to lines 1.1 and 1.2; lines 2, 3, 4 and 5 are withdrawn from C1. C1 remains optional and excluded from Total A+B.

items.title: Two-Year Operation Spare Parts (VDR Information Only)
items.jutalComment: for information only, no purchase and it is pare of VDR.
items.mrRequirement: Two years of normal operation spare parts.
items.offeredBasis: 11 optional lines in Annex C2 (excluded from Total A+B).
items.response: Noted. C2 is provided as VDR information only, not for purchase, and remains excluded from Total A+B.
